metadata.description: The Bearing marketplace: bearing (required: the workflow, agents, hooks and templates), bearing-backend and bearing-apps (optional stack conventions).

plugins.name: bearing
plugins.description: A developer workflow for coding agents: skills for every stage, review subagents, hooks and repository templates. Required.

plugins.name: bearing-backend
plugins.description: Stack conventions and templates for Go, Python, Node, data pipelines and infrastructure. Optional; needs bearing.

plugins.name: bearing-apps
plugins.description: Stack conventions and templates for React, Next.js, React Native, Flutter, iOS and Android. Optional; needs bearing.
